environment.description: Staging Apollo GraphQL server on same EKS cluster (us-east-1) in namespace graphql-staging. Split.io SDK configured with staging workspace API key. The 'deep_enrichment_v2' split definition in this workspace has targeting rules: default treatment is 'off', with a percentage rollout segment configured at 0% for 'on' treatment. The split was created on 2024-02-01 and has never been toggled to 'on' in this workspace. Note: the split definition exists (not a missing key scenario) so the SDK returns the defined default treatment 'off' rather than the SDK's hardcoded control value. The staging workspace has an additional kill switch rule at priority 1 that forces treatment 'off' for all server-side keys matching pattern 'server-*'. Node.js 18.x runtime, same container image as production.

config.split_kill_switch_rule: priority 1: if key matches 'server-*' then treatment 'off'
